paragraphs.text:
Twin cries from the rear let you know that both Bernard 
and Charlie have been hit. You throw a quick glance over 
your shoulder. Bernard is down, and Charlie manages only 
a couple of steps more before collapsing. Behind them, the 
creatures swarm.
To turn back to help them, go to 332. To race on alone, go to 151.
